title: outbox definitions
description: Outbox items of POST /v1/device/outbox and their bodies per item_kind (03-api.md section 6.1).

body_session_transition.description: session state change reported by the runner (03-api.md section 6.1)

wait_until.description: KOR-50, ADR-081 section 4: with reason model_quota_exhausted the time the runner resumes the session by itself (null: unknown)

dfx_choice.description: KOR-50, ADR-081 section 3: with reason model_quota_exhausted, DFX access would be available but the owner's setting does not allow it (the task may ask for consent)

body_vm_state.description: VM row as reported by the runner (02-data-model.md section 2.4); optional upgrade (the switch status of an outdated workgroup VM, null once current; absent: unchanged) and replaced_by (on the deleted report of a VM switched to a newer golden), ADR-093 section 3

body_operation_transition.description: operation state change after registration (03-api.md section 6.1)

delta.description: increments since the previous usage item

model.description: model of the requests of this delta (KOR-31, 12-billing.md section 4); without it the session's model_id counts

access_origin.description: whose model access the requests used: own (the user's subscription or API key, free), operator (an operator subscription of DFX, ADR-052) or platform (the platform's OpenRouter key); the last two are charged; read only from platform devices (12-billing.md section 4, AUD-04 W10)

at.description: time of the request (selects the price list version); without it the hub's receive time

triggered_by.description: the person whose instruction this follows from (ADR-083 section 2): the acting user of the turn, or of the subagent.request of a child session; null when the turn had several authors or none

body_quota.description: The windows the device fetched for the owner, or `unavailable: true` when the usage endpoint refused the owner's subscription token (401/403; 05-runner.md section 10.6): the hub then drops the owner's older windows. Optional `limited` (KOR-50, ADR-081 section 6): the latest observed limit of the owner's subscription; sent only to a hub whose device state carries model_fallback.api >= 1. Optional `subscription_id` (KOR-69, ADR-090 section 4): the reading belongs to that non-primary subscription record of the owner (without it: the owner's primary record); sent only to a hub whose device state carries subscriptions.api >= 1.

metric_sample.description: one raw metric sample (02-data-model.md section 2.8); entity_id is the device or session UUID or the vm ID or the work VM ID

session_id.description: entity_kind workvm only, and there required (the hub refuses a workvm sample without it): the session the work VM belongs to (its own session, else the session that requested the task VM); 13-work-vm.md section 10, KOR-29

body_wrap.description: a key wrap created under W2 (as POST /v1/device/wraps)

body_runtime.description: VM runtime of a platform device attributed to one session (12-billing.md section 4): 0 < runtime_ms <= to - from, at most one hour per item

triggered_by.description: the person whose instruction this follows from (ADR-083 section 2): the acting user of the turn, or of the subagent.request of a child session; null when the turn had several authors or none

body_audit.description: audit row written by the runner (03-api.md section 6.1): one variant per action of enums/outbox-audit-actions.json with the detail of audit/<action>.json inlined (metadata only)

target_id.description: an ID (UUID, vm-..., key or code), never content

detail.description: detail of audit rows with action hook.denied: PreToolUse deny: tool name and rule number of 05-runner.md section 5.3, never the path. detail.description: detail of audit rows with action session.model_switched: the runner moved a session to another model access because its access was used up, could not be used or was released again (ADR-081 sections 4 and 5), or continued a session whose access the provider refused once a renewed or another access was there (cause renewed, HOT-26; from_access and to_access may be equal), or holds a session whose subscription does not cover its model while no subscription with access to that model is free (cause model_unavailable, HOT-26; the session's model on both sides, until null): the access kinds and models before and after, the cause and the release time of the used-up access (null without one). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.

item.description: one outbox item: origin_seq gapless from 1, item_kind of enums/outbox-item-kinds.json, its body

quota_window.description: one quota window of a subscription (05-runner.md section 10.6)

quota_limited.description: the latest observed limit of the subscription (ADR-081 sections 2 and 6, runner.access_limit): when it was marked used up, its release time (null: unknown) and whether the release time is the provider's own (readable quota) or a probe time after a streak of 429 answers

operator_subscription.description: one operator subscription file of a platform device as its runner observes it (ADR-081 section 6): the file name chosen by the operator, never a token

body_operator_quota.description: the complete snapshot of the operator subscriptions of a platform device (ADR-081 section 6); the hub keeps the newest per device and refuses the item from an org device (403 forbidden)

body_dfx_key_state.description: whether this platform device can issue per-device DFX keys (it holds a management key of the model provider, ADR-081 section 7); refused from an org device (403 forbidden)

body_dfx_key_issued.description: the issuer created the key of a request of its device state and sealed it to the org device (ADR-081 section 7); the hub stores the envelope only

envelope.description: base64url of the sealed and signed key envelope (ADR-081 section 7); opaque to the hub

body_dfx_key_usage.description: the provider's cumulative spend of one per-device key (ADR-081 section 7); the hub books the difference to the highest figure it booked for the key

body_session_wait.description: the model-quota wait of a session (KOR-50, ADR-081 sections 3 and 4): when it continues by itself (null clears the wait) and whether DFX access would be available but the crossing rule bars it; the hub keeps the newest report by `at` and accepts it only from the device the session runs on
